description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator, which provides additional presentation or processing logic for EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for formatting dates, retrieving country names, and setting employee references based on employee numbers.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing additional methods for the EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, such as formatted dates and country names.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity in the record based on the provided employee number.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country associated with the record, based on the country code.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the document type as a string, mapped from type code.
